elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Going away? Your fridge has a secret holiday setting.

[intrigued] Here's the hidden setting. Holiday mode, right on the control panel.

[friendly] Empty out anything perishable. Select Holiday or Vacation on the panel. Keep the doors closed. Switch back to normal a day before you're home. Don't leave fresh food in there while it's on.

[delighted] The freezer keeps running, and you save energy.

[warm] Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
